guarantees.claim: On every rising edge of clk_i, if rst_ni is low cool_down_ct_q is cleared to all zeros; otherwise cool_down_ct_q is loaded with the value of cool_down_ct_d.

assumptions.claim: The external reset controller must assert rst_ni low at least once after power‑up to bring cool_down_ct_q to a known state of all zeros before the first non‑reset clock edge.
assumptions.cond: During initial power‑on or system‑wide reset.
assumptions.risk: If the reset is skipped, cool_down_ct_q may power up to an arbitrary value, making the cool‑down timer unpredictable and possibly violating mandatory idle or wipe sequencing that depends on the counter being initialized to zero.
